reuse.why: Routes four inline midpoint copies through the existing exported getScheduledAmount helper, which already handled missing/number/range.

duplication.why: Removes all inline range arithmetic; the only remaining dispatch (schedule-template's isbetween ternary) calls the shared range function.

placement.why: The new rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, which every layer already imports.

scope.why: Only the range rule, its call sites, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: A future change to the ranged-amount rule is a one-line edit in getWorstCaseRangeAmount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All sites use getScheduledAmount or getWorstCaseRangeAmount; schedule-template keeps its own isbetween op check but delegates the range value.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic remains; copies were replaced by calls.

one_place.where: getWorstCaseRangeAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount (forecast, schedules/app updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, client components) and directly by budget/schedule-template.ts.
